priceSnapshot.note: The breakout day closed strong but not on its high. Midday published at 85,904.7; six hours and forty-three minutes later spot is 86,266.8, up 362.1 points or 0.42 percent on the handover, and up 5.79 percent on the 24-hour open of 81,548.3. Between the two reports the tape ran 85,806.6 to 87,399.0 - a 1,592.4-point box whose high is the highest BTC print since 29 January 2026 - and then gave back 1,132.2 points, or 1.30 percent, from that high into the close. Three settled four-hour bodies now sit above the 85,631.3 January shelf: 85,931.7 at 12:00 UTC, 86,502.3 at 16:00 UTC, 86,617.8 at 20:00 UTC. The live 00:00 UTC four-hour bar is the first one trading red, opening 86,617.9 and printing 86,300.8 at its low.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 85,325.2. That number is the high the morning file printed and the shelf midday nominated as its retest-buy level, so it is the line the breakout has to defend to still be called a breakout. The gate trails up 1,628.1 points from midday's 83,697.1 because the market has since built two more settled 4H bodies above the January high and put its low for the session at 85,806.6 - 83,697.1 is now a disaster level, not a management level. A wick underneath is not enough, exactly as on 19 and 20 September when wicks either side of 82,099.0 resolved the other way.

addIf.confirmation: A pullback into 85,600.0 that HOLDS on a settled 1H close. 85,600.0 is the low of the 16:00-20:00 UTC four-hour bar, the base the final leg of today's advance launched from, and it sits just above the 15m EMA50 at 85,837.32 and well above the 1H EMA20 at 85,080.75. Buying that retest is a materially better entry than buying 86,300.0 with 4H RSI at 86.43. The continuation alternative is a settled 4H close above 87,399.0, today's eight-month high, which clears the last measured short-liquidation pocket at 87,250.0 and leaves nothing structural until 88,857.0.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from midday's ADD to TAKE_PROFIT, and the reason is the calendar as much as the chart. Midday's add was a pre-committed rule firing and it worked - 12 USDT bought at 85,904.7 is 362.1 points onside. What has changed is that this is the last report of the day and the next one is roughly six hours away on the far side of the overnight gap, with a daily ATR of 2,562.85: one average day of range from 86,266.8 lands at 83,703.9, which is almost exactly where midday's old reduce gate sat. Against that, 4H RSI is 86.43 - higher than the 82.71 midday already flagged as a 300-bar extreme - the day's high was rejected by 1,132.2 points, the 15m MACD histogram is negative at minus 74.83, and open interest FELL 3.35 percent while price rose, so the short-covering fuel that drove the last leg has largely been spent. The trim is deliberately small, 10 percent of the spot book, because the strongest new fact of the day argues the other way and it is a big one: Farside now prints plus 617.6 million USD of US spot-ETF inflow for 21 September, a third consecutive positive day and the allocation confirmation midday said was missing. So 90 percent of the core stays long and a resting stop, not a flat book, carries the overnight. The reduce gate trails up to 85,325.2, the add gate inverts into a retest buy at 85,600.0, invalidation trails up from 82,099.0 to 84,719.5 - today's session low, because losing it overnight would mean the eight-month-high break was a one-day event - and a stop order is now recommended at 84,650.0.

overnightRisk: The gap from here to the ~02:00 COT midnight report is the widest blind spot of the day and it opens with price 1,132.2 points off an eight-month high, 4H RSI at 86.43, and a daily ATR of 2,562.85 - one average day of range takes 86,266.8 down to 83,703.9 or up to 88,829.7 without anything unusual happening. Five specific catalysts. FIRST, the 08:00 UTC funding settlement on BTC-USDT-SWAP is stamped at plus 0.0001, the practical floor, so nobody is paying carry to be long and there is no crowded-long premium to unwind - this is the one item that argues the downside gap is shallower than the RSI implies. SECOND, the OKX long/short account ratio is 0.93 and has printed 0.95, 0.94, 0.94, 0.93 over the last four hourly buckets: accounts are still net SHORT into a rising tape, which keeps forced buying, not forced selling, as the crowded-side risk. THIRD, working against both of those, open interest is 2,564,275,351 USD, down 3.35 percent from midday's 2,653,274,142 while price rose 0.42 percent - positions were closed into strength rather than added, so the squeeze that produced 87,399.0 has less fuel left than it did six hours ago. FOURTH, the measured liquidation map is unusually tight and unusually two-sided: the 86,500.0 bucket alone took 189,548 USD of long and 164,934 USD of short fills in the same four-hour window, so the immediate overnight risk is a whipsaw through 86,250.0-86,750.0 that pays nobody, and thin Asian-hours books make that stop-run cheap to engineer. FIFTH, tonight's Farside print of plus 617.6 million USD lands after the fact - the flow is confirmed, but the Asian session gets to decide whether a third positive day is a reason to mark BTC higher or a reason to sell strength into confirmed demand. Extreme Greed at 78 on the Fear and Greed Index says sentiment has no cushion left. The resting stop at 84,650.0, below today's 84,719.5 low, is the only protection that works while nobody is watching; a settled reclaim of 86,750.0 would say the whipsaw resolved upward.

liquidation.note: 71,042 USD of LONG liquidations against 1,847 USD of shorts, sitting essentially on top of live spot at 86,266.8. These are the chasers who bought the run toward 87,399.0 and were flushed on the retrace. Realized fills map where leverage has already died, not where stops are resting now.

The largest and the most interesting cluster in the window: 189,548 USD of long liquidations AND 164,934 USD of short liquidations in the same 250-dollar bucket, 354,482 USD total. Both sides were taken out at the same price, which is the signature of a whipsaw rather than a trend. It is the nearest magnet above and the level a thin overnight book is most likely to revisit in both directions.

85,294 USD of longs and 28,345 USD of shorts, 113,639 USD total. Still two-sided but tilting long-heavy, which extends the chop band up to here. A settled reclaim above it is the cleanest single sign that the overnight whipsaw resolved upward.

18,085 USD, all SHORT liquidations - the only pocket in the window with no long fills at all. Thin, but it is forced buying, and it sits directly under today's 87,399.0 high, which is why a break of that high has a small air pocket working for it.

timeframes.structure: The chart that governs a weeks-to-months stance is the calmest of the four, and that asymmetry is the single most useful fact in this file. Daily RSI 71.60 has only just crossed into overbought while the 4H screams 86.43, which is what a trend looks like when it is starting rather than ending. The EMAs are stacked 20 over 50 over 100, and the 100 at 72,386.04 has crossed back above the 200 at 73,129.85's level - price at 86,266.8 is 17.96 percent above the EMA200. The MACD histogram is positive at plus 309.78 and widening. Note the candle convention: OKX daily bars settle on a UTC+8 boundary, so the newest settled daily bar is stamped 2026-09-20T16:00:00Z and closed 85,931.7 while the live bar has already printed 87,399.0. The 300-bar high remains 97,925.4, so this move is a recovery inside a larger range, not a new all-time-high regime.

etfFlows.note: This is the headline of the endday file. The 21 September row on Farside is no longer a zero placeholder: it prints plus 617.6 million USD, the largest single-day US spot-Bitcoin-ETF inflow of the month and the third consecutive positive day after 17 September at plus 159.5 and 18 September at plus 433.0 - a three-day streak worth plus 1,210.1 million. The rolling five-session net swings to plus 463.8 million from minus 450.4 on the 15th and minus 295.9 on the 16th. Midday named this exact print as the confirmation datapoint that would decide whether the eight-month-high break was allocation-driven or perpetual-driven, and it landed on the allocation side. Read together with open interest FALLING 3.35 percent over the same hours, the picture is spot buyers absorbing leveraged sellers, which is the healthier of the two ways to make a high. divergences.note: Price made a higher high between the midday and endday reports - 85,904.7 to 86,266.8, with a 87,399.0 print in between - while the 15-minute MACD histogram stayed negative across the whole span. The histogram is less negative than it was, so this is a weak, short-horizon divergence rather than a reversal signal, but it is the reason the 86,250.0-86,750.0 band reads as chop and the reason a 10 percent trim is preferred to a 10 percent add. The larger non-oscillator divergence is recorded in macro.liquidations and overnightRisk: price rose 0.42 percent on the handover while open interest FELL 3.35 percent, 88,998,791 USD of notional leaving the perpetual, which marks the last leg to 87,399.0 as short covering rather than fresh long demand.

Recorded as a warning rather than a divergence in the textbook sense: 4H RSI did NOT diverge, it confirmed, climbing with price from 82.71 to 86.43. That is the point. 86.43 is the highest reading in the entire 299-bar series, so the oscillator is not warning of weakness, it is warning of pace. Momentum confirmation at this extreme is historically where a trend pauses rather than where it turns, which is exactly why the endday stance banks 10 percent and keeps 90 percent with a resting stop instead of flattening.

calibration.note: Midday was right on both the read and the trade, which has not been true often this month, and it is worth being precise about why. The read: bias bullish at 55 percent, reduce gate at 83,697.1, and the session low came in at 85,806.6 - 2,109.5 points of clearance, so priorReduceFired is false and it was never close. The trade: midday took ADD and bought 12 USDT of spot at 85,904.7 on a pre-committed rule, a settled 4H close above 85,631.3. Spot is now 86,266.8, so that slice is 362.1 points or 0.42 percent onside, worth about plus 0.05 USDT, and actingHelped is true. The primary add level of 85,325.2 never traded - the low was 85,806.6, 481.4 points above it - so the calibration row records add_fired false at that price; midday's stated ALTERNATIVE add, a settled 4H close above 86,351.4, did fill at 16:00 UTC with a close of 86,502.3, which is the leg that actually paid. Two things midday got specifically right and both were process rather than opinion: it honoured a gate written six hours earlier instead of flinching at the higher price, and it sized the add partial at 12 of 42.89 USDT because 4H RSI at 82.71 argued the other way. That RSI is now 86.43, which is the same argument with more force, and it is why this session banks a slice instead of pressing. The standing error to keep naming is the morning trim at 84,742.7, which is still 1,524.1 points offside; today's lesson is that in the first session of a genuine range break, a record RSI is evidence a trend is starting, not evidence of a top - and the corollary, which the endday trim leans on, is that by the third settled 4H body above the old ceiling the RSI argument has earned back some weight.
